title: Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF30: Matte SPF Moisturizer, Filters & How to Use
description:
Dermalogica clearing defense SPF30, on the Cape Town daily sun care desk: what it is, its filters and how to wear it every day.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link at https://dermatology.capetown/.

• Shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress (59 ml)
• Broad spectrum; active filters homosalate 8%, octocrylene 8%, octisalate 5%, avobenzone 3%
• Natural tapioca helps reduce shine; willow bark extract, green tea extract and vitamin C
• Apply a generous amount to cleansed face and neck, preferably 30 minutes before sun exposure; reapply as recommended
• Very dry skin may feel drier; the listing suggests layering a hydrating lotion underneath
